title: A report without the tile's preset opens on the same dates as Custom
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and, for Sales, Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization and Sales By Customer, open the Date control and write down its choices.
  2. Compare each list with the tile presets: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week.
  3. If a report lacks one of those presets, go to the Dashboard, set that report's tile to the missing preset and write down the tile's calendar dates.
  4. If no report lacks a preset, instead open the Revenue tile's calendar, pick a start day and an end day yourself (e.g. Aug 3, 2026 to Aug 17, 2026) and click Apply.
  5. Click the tile's report icon.
  6. Read the report's Date control and the dates it covers.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The report opens on exactly the dates the tile showed (e.g. Aug 3, 2026 to Aug 17, 2026).
  • Its Date control shows Custom, because the report has no matching preset.
  • If every tile preset was found in every report (expected today) and the tile calendar does not let you pick your own days, write 'not reachable by hand today' in the result comment and mark the case Blocked.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 10. Context note: reached only if a report's date list changes later. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 03_Range_After (the tile's calendar with Apply), used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-E1: “If a report does not offer the tile's preset, the report opens with the same dates and its date-range control shows "Custom".”
  • S10-E1: “If a report does not offer the tile's preset, the report opens with the same dates and its date-range control shows "Custom".”
  • Context note (Story 10, when the Custom fallback is reached): “with S10-R7 in place, every tile preset exists in every linked report, so S10-E1 is reached only if a report's date list changes later.”
